# pai issue

Claim and release forge issues for this project

```
pai issue <command>
```

Claim and release forge issues for this project.

```sh
pai issue claims
pai issue claim 12
```

### pai issue claim

Mark issue N as yours (assignee and in-progress label)

```
pai issue claim N [options]
```

Mark issue N as yours (assignee and in-progress label).

Claim forge issue <n> of this project (assignee claude + label in-progress)

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N` | yes | Issue number |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Print the requests that would modify the issue; send none |

```sh
pai issue claim 12
pai issue claim 12 --dry-run
```

See also: `pai issue release`

### pai issue release

Give issue N back

```
pai issue release N [options]
```

Give issue N back.

Release forge issue <n> of this project (assignee claude + label in-progress)

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N` | yes | Issue number |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Print the requests that would modify the issue; send none |

```sh
pai issue release 12
pai issue release 12 --dry-run
```

See also: `pai issue claims`, `pai issue claim`

### pai issue claims

List the issues of this project marked in-progress

```
pai issue claims
```

List the issues of this project marked in-progress.

List open issues of this project carrying the in-progress label

```sh
pai issue claims
pai issue claims
```

See also: `pai issue stale`, `pai issue release`

### pai issue stale

List open issues whose work is already merged

```
pai issue stale [options]
```

List open issues whose work is already merged.

List open issues that landed in the integration branch (merged branch named by number, or a 'fixes #N' commit subject; plain mentions do not count) or are idle (report only; never closes)

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--days N` | string | — | Idle threshold in days |
| `--json` | flag | — | JSON output |
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Also show the handover-issue section the daemon would write; send nothing |

```sh
pai issue stale
pai issue stale --days 14 --json
```

See also: `pai issue claims`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai issue claim` | Mark issue N as yours (assignee and in-progress label) |
| `pai issue release` | Give issue N back |
| `pai issue claims` | List the issues of this project marked in-progress |
| `pai issue stale` | List open issues whose work is already merged |
